74.902.22.reason: A signalised junction starts about 30 m before the station, so a red light alone slows this road

34.121.03.reason: Weekday evenings only, the shape of the commute rather than of fuel demand

24.351.97.reason: Scattered across hours; the road before the station is slow even at usual times, which points to a fixed road feature
